description: This source file implements the KernelLogMonitor class, which manages kernel log pipes, provides diagnostic information, and integrates with a dependency injection framework. It handles creation of pipes, command generation, and exposes the kernel log pipe for other components.

classes.name: KernelLogMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors kernel logs, manages log pipes, and provides diagnostic info within the Cuttlefish virtualization environment.

methods.name: Diagnostics
methods.description: Returns diagnostic information about the kernel log, specifically the path to the kernel log file.

methods.name: LateInject
methods.description: Performs late dependency injection, determining the number of event pipes from multibindings.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates and returns commands to start kernel log monitoring, including parameters for log pipe file descriptors.

methods.name: KernelLogPipe
methods.description: Provides access to the kernel log pipe, ensuring one is available and removing it from the internal list.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the feature, 'KernelLogMonitor'.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Sets up the kernel log pipe and associated pipes, handling creation and error checking.
